title: AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile Shares Slip As SpaceX Reportedly Holds Cell Tower Talks For Starlink Mobile
summary: The report of SpaceX’s talks with key cell tower companies comes just weeks after Musk’s company secured a deal to acquire nationwide low-band wireless spectrum.
